subject: Re: Prioritizing pen-test slot — condensed ops brief + evidence handback
messages:
From: Alyssa Deng <alyssa.deng@finova.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Finova Security Team <security@finova.com>, Tom Patel <tom.patel@finova.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Prioritizing pen-test slot — can we compress the walkthrough?

Hi Michael,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We need to lock the next steps for the SOC 2 / DPA review and to book the pen-test kickoff. Our internal schedule is tight and the security team has asked to prioritize the pen-test window; they want an initial surface-level walkthrough first (we can do a deeper controls handover later).

Would Redwood be able to run a condensed 40–45 minute operational walkthrough focused on pen-test scope and evidence touchpoints, followed by a separate evidence-handoff doc/drive transfer? Ideally we need an APAC-friendly slot (SGT or AEST preferred) between Sep 13–17.

I've attached our preliminary questionnaire — it will help you triage attendees and what evidence we'll ask for. Also please include any drafts of your pen-test scope so our vendor can pre-read.

Attachments: SOC2_Questionnaire_Draft.pdf

Thanks,
Alyssa Deng
Security Program Manager
Finova

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Deng <alyssa.deng@finova.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 19:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Prioritizing pen-test slot — can we compress the walkthrough?

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the clear ask and for sending the questionnaire. We can absolutely prioritize the pen-test focus.

Quick options:
- Option A (condensed): 45 minutes focused on pen-test scope, network access, and evidence owners, followed by a separate evidence handoff doc + drive.
  * Proposed slot: Sep 13 at 01:00 UTC (09:00 SGT / 11:00 AEST) — 45 min
- Option B (full): 90 minutes for SOC2 + pen overview and quick run through evidence map.
  * Proposed slot: Sep 13 at 02:30 UTC (10:30 SGT) — 90 min

Attendees from our side: Irene Choi (platform/security eng), Ben Carter (solutions security lead), and me. If you confirm Option A, we will prepare a short PenTest_Scope_Draft.docx and an evidence map (Redwood_Evidence_Map.xlsx) to share ahead of the call.

If neither of those times works, tell us two APAC windows that suit your SOC team and we'll prioritize. Also, if you prefer a calendar invite instead of Calendly, we can send it.

-Michael
Michael Grant
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

From: Alyssa Deng <alyssa.deng@finova.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Patel <tom.patel@finova.com>, Finova Security Team <security@finova.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 02:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Prioritizing pen-test slot — can we compress the walkthrough?

Thanks Michael — Option A (45 min) is perfect. We absolutely need the pen-test scope doc in advance so our third-party vendor can calibrate.

Confirming preference for Sep 13 at 09:00 SGT (01:00 UTC). Please keep the agenda tight: 1) pen-test scope & expected access 2) evidence owners and locations 3) immediate blockers. No need to walk all SOC2 controls in this session.

Also: our vendor requires a short scope artifact and any test account access instructions (if available) in the shared drive ahead of the kickoff.

We will accept a calendar invite.

Best,
Alyssa

- 20:00–35:00: Evidence locations and owner handoff (Ben)
- 35:00–45:00: Q&A + immediate blockers and next steps

I created a quick calendar invite and included a Calendly fallback if anything changes: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/45min-ops-brief?date=2026-09-13

Attachments: PenTest_Scope_Draft.docx, Redwood_Evidence_Map.xlsx

Bridge: Zoom (details in invite)

-Michael

Thanks everyone — invite received and accepted. We downloaded the two attachments and gave the vendor access to the drive link; they asked one quick clarification: will any VPN/accounts be created ahead of the test or is the vendor expected to use existing test accounts? If Redwood prefers to create scoped test accounts, please indicate in the evidence handoff doc.

We prefer Redwood to list the expected access pattern in the drive doc (username pattern, ephemeral creds, or VPN instructions) so the vendor can prepare. Looking forward to the 45m kickoff on Sep 13 — we will have our vendor lead on the call.

Best,
Tom Patel
Security Ops Lead
Finova
